title: UniVault Employment Credential – subject claims (v1.0)
description: Claims an employer issues about an employee. Validated by the issuer before signing. Envelope claims (iss, iat, exp, vct, cnf, status, jti, issuer_name, schema_version) are added by the backend and are not part of this schema. Sources: employer schema letters (Employer A, 15 May 2026; Employer B, 18 May 2026).

employee_id.description: Employer-assigned employee number (A: Employee ID Number; B: Employee Number).

full_name.description: Full name as held in HR records (A, B).

nic_number.description: Sri Lankan NIC, old (9 digits + V/X) or new (12 digits) format (B only). Note: an NIC encodes date of birth and gender.

designation.description: Job title (A: Designation; B: Job Position / Designation).

department.description: Department (A: Department; B: Department or Work Area).

employment_type.description: Contract basis (A: Employment Status; B: Employment Category). Whether the person is currently employed is shown by the credential's revocation status, not by this field.

work_location.description: Branch or work location (A: Branch / Location).

work_phone.description: Work contact number in E.164 format (B: Contact Information).

portrait.description: Employee photograph as a JPEG data URI, max ~50 KB (B: Employee Photograph). Supports visual identification, which interviewees said is still needed.

excludedSourceFields.residential_address: Not needed to prove employment; data minimisation (PDPA). Address is carried by the KYC credential.
excludedSourceFields.supervisor_details: Personal data of a third party.
excludedSourceFields.emergency_contact: Personal data of a third party.
